title: Engineering framework repository policy
description: Repository-owned configuration for the engineering framework. Declares what this repository IS - its canonical commands and its high-risk paths - so the gates run the right checks and pick the right ceremony. It carries no permission or enforcement keys: from 1.0.0 the framework ships methodology only, and permissions belong to the repository and its owner.

frameworkVersion.description: The engineering-framework version this repository's contract was written against, as MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. framework-doctor compares it against the installed version and reports a major-version gap.

commands.description: This repository's canonical verification commands. The validation gate prefers these over anything it infers. Omit a key rather than inventing a command that does not exist.

highRiskPaths.description: Globs that force at least High risk when a change touches them, whatever the change looks like otherwise.

notes.description: One paragraph on what makes this system risky that a reader could not infer from the code.
